units.rawText: Dormitory, the Oasis.
units.displayText: Dormitory, the Oasis.

spans.text: Dormitory, the Oasis.

units.rawText: I softly push open one of the doors. The room is filled with all kinds of tools for exploration, and a piece of orange workwear.
units.displayText: I softly push open one of the doors. The room is filled with all kinds of tools for exploration, and a piece of orange workwear.

spans.text: I softly push open one of the doors. The room is filled with all kinds of tools for exploration, and a piece of orange workwear.

units.rawText: The room has remained unchanged since she left, just as our memory of her has never faded.
units.displayText: The room has remained unchanged since she left, just as our memory of her has never faded.

spans.text: The room has remained unchanged since she left, just as our memory of her has never faded.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: ...We've identified Eosphorus' weakness and the next opportunity for a breakthrough. As you wished, the Oasis will press on, moving forward to the next battle...
units.displayText: ...We've identified Eosphorus' weakness and the next opportunity for a breakthrough. As you wished, the Oasis will press on, moving forward to the next battle...

spans.text: ...We've identified Eosphorus' weakness and the next opportunity for a breakthrough. As you wished, the Oasis will press on, moving forward to the next battle...

units.rawText: If you were still with us, I believe you'd take pride in all that we've done.
units.displayText: If you were still with us, I believe you'd take pride in all that we've done.

spans.text: If you were still with us, I believe you'd take pride in all that we've done.

units.rawText: Persicaria... she would probably be standing aside and adding details while calming you down, then work with you to correct Croque and Antonina's snarky comments.
units.displayText: Persicaria... she would probably be standing aside and adding details while calming you down, then work with you to correct Croque and Antonina's snarky comments.

spans.text: Persicaria... she would probably be standing aside and adding details while calming you down, then work with you to correct Croque and Antonina's snarky comments.

units.rawText: Although I still don't fully remember what our first encounter was like, I feel like I can naturally picture the scene of you smiling at me, the moment we first meet.
units.displayText: Although I still don't fully remember what our first encounter was like, I feel like I can naturally picture the scene of you smiling at me, the moment we first meet.

spans.text: Although I still don't fully remember what our first encounter was like, I feel like I can naturally picture the scene of you smiling at me, the moment we first meet.

units.rawText: I sure can imagine it too... Wait a second, is "snarky" the only word you associate with me?
units.displayText: I sure can imagine it too... Wait a second, is "snarky" the only word you associate with me?

spans.text: I sure can imagine it too... Wait a second, is "snarky" the only word you associate with me?

units.rawText: Antonina, what brought you here?
units.displayText: Antonina, what brought you here?

spans.text: Antonina, what brought you here?

units.rawText: ...It just crossed my mind, and it seems that I'm not the only one who had that sudden idea.
units.displayText: ...It just crossed my mind, and it seems that I'm not the only one who had that sudden idea.

spans.text: ...It just crossed my mind, and it seems that I'm not the only one who had that sudden idea.

units.rawText: What a coincidence, everyone's here.
units.displayText: What a coincidence, everyone's here.

spans.text: What a coincidence, everyone's here.

units.rawText: True, never thought we'd all be thinking the same thing.
units.displayText: True, never thought we'd all be thinking the same thing.

spans.text: True, never thought we'd all be thinking the same thing.

units.rawText: Persicaria steps into the center of the room, gently placing a bottle containing a sprouting blade of grass onto the table.
units.displayText: Persicaria steps into the center of the room, gently placing a bottle containing a sprouting blade of grass onto the table.

spans.text: Persicaria steps into the center of the room, gently placing a bottle containing a sprouting blade of grass onto the table.

units.rawText: Sol... This piece of sturdy grass is rooting and sprouting again, and the flowers are blossoming throughout the Oasis once more. This grass... comes from the Oasis, and I've bottled it for you.
units.displayText: Sol... This piece of sturdy grass is rooting and sprouting again, and the flowers are blossoming throughout the Oasis once more. This grass... comes from the Oasis, and I've bottled it for you.

spans.text: Sol... This piece of sturdy grass is rooting and sprouting again, and the flowers are blossoming throughout the Oasis once more. This grass... comes from the Oasis, and I've bottled it for you.

units.rawText: We'll soon press forward along the path you've cleared for us. Until we meet again... Arvak, Alsvid, and your bottle will be safe with me.
units.displayText: We'll soon press forward along the path you've cleared for us. Until we meet again... Arvak, Alsvid, and your bottle will be safe with me.

spans.text: We'll soon press forward along the path you've cleared for us. Until we meet again... Arvak, Alsvid, and your bottle will be safe with me.

units.rawText: If we ever meet again, I bet you'd say you're the brain, not the brawn... even though you never really had the capacity to be that in the first place.
units.displayText: If we ever meet again, I bet you'd say you're the brain, not the brawn... even though you never really had the capacity to be that in the first place.

spans.text: If we ever meet again, I bet you'd say you're the brain, not the brawn... even though you never really had the capacity to be that in the first place.

units.rawText: And you'd force me to socialize again... Hngh, my head hurts just thinking about it.
units.displayText: And you'd force me to socialize again... Hngh, my head hurts just thinking about it.

spans.text: And you'd force me to socialize again... Hngh, my head hurts just thinking about it.

units.rawText: I think she'd be acting like a dork, as usual.
units.displayText: I think she'd be acting like a dork, as usual.

spans.text: I think she'd be acting like a dork, as usual.

units.rawText: Maybe she'd be the same, always protecting others, even as she's covered in scars...
units.displayText: Maybe she'd be the same, always protecting others, even as she's covered in scars...

spans.text: Maybe she'd be the same, always protecting others, even as she's covered in scars...

units.rawText: Sol, we'll meet again. Whether it's in the Cloud or the real world, you'll always be our dearest friend, no matter what.
